text:
Jean-Gabriel Pageau missed a game last week and was a game-time decision before returning, He has one goal and eight points in 19 games, and he centered Matias Maccelli and Heineman at the latest morning skate.

Our numbers are not kind about the five-on-five play. The Islanders take 46% of the expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), almost seven points worse than without him, and Evolving-Hockey had opponents creating more with him on last season than against all but 4% of forwards. The team has scored about 4.8 more goals than its chances with him out there, so the points are, if anything, flattered. What Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking still likes is the puck work: 73% of his exits leave the zone with possession, and he carries the puck in on 56% of his entries. At 34, his value is now in those details. Our range has him around 37 points.
